title: Verdant Ruins: The Herbalist's Civic Seed
premise: In a forest city reclaimed by root-powered civic machines, the herbalist must isolate the cure from hazardous blooms using a woven specimen satchel.
ending: Recover the Civic Seed and return with the restorative field formula; Green Assembly can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive spore plume while evading the canopy defender without sacrificing the restorative field formula.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Green Assembly to witness the woven specimen satchel.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to harvest a rare living specimen
